cards.card_text: God sends him to a family called the Rechabites, to bring them into one of the rooms of the house of the LORD and offer them a drink of wine.
cards.verse_text: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah: “Go to the house of the Rechabites, speak to them, and bring them to one of the chambers of the house of the LORD to offer them a drink of wine.”

cards.card_text: God sent the prophet Jeremiah to bring the Rechabites, and he starts with Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah (a different Jeremiah).
cards.verse_text: So I took Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brothers and all his sons—the entire house of the Rechabites—
cards.snippet: …Habazziniah, and his brothers and all his sons—the entire house of the Rechabites—

cards.card_text: Then Jeremiah turns to the Rechabites with a word from the LORD of Hosts: they obeyed Jonadab, kept all his commandments, and did all he charged them to do.
